Financial services provider OneMain Financial is facing a class action lawsuit following a data breach that allegedly exposed unencrypted personally identifiable information (PII). 

The legal filing claims that failure to properly secure stored data led to the unauthorized exposure. The full scope of the breach and the total number of impacted individuals are not yet confirmed.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
According to the claims, unencrypted PII was compromised during the breach, indicating potential gaps in storage security and data-at-rest encryption protocols within the affected environment.
